notes: embedding_source names where the vectors in records.json/cases.json came from.
'hashing-stub-v1' means NO vectors are committed and the harness derives them
from the deterministic bag-of-words stub at seed time. Under that tag the hybrid
arm exercises fusion MECHANICS only — it says nothing about semantic quality,
because the stub makes vocabulary-mismatch cases near-orthogonal exactly like FTS.
To make the hybrid arm meaningful, regenerate with real vectors from the deployed
space and flip this tag to 'minilm-l6-v2-256@sentence-transformers'. See README.md.
The backend embeds nothing by design, so real vectors are always generated
out-of-band by a runner and committed as data.
